serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Don’t worry, I will still enjoy eating with you.
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
You: I’m glad to hear that.
You: There are also art galleries. Visiting them is very interesting. {{wi}}At least that’s what I heard.
Bot: Have you never been to an art gallery before?
You: Long time ago with my highschool class, but I’m sure if we went together it would be a lot different.
Bot: What kind of art is displayed there?
You: It depends on the current exhibition. There could be paintings, some statues or some weird ‘modern art’, but the last one is kinda passe.
Bot: Sounds great, but can’t we just look up some works of art on your computer?
You: I guess we could, but going out together would be more fun, right?
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Sure!
You: Then it’s settled. We will go out the next chance we have.
